name: PEP-II
notes: Injected by the SLAC linac (accelerator:slac-linac). The earlier version of this record listed accelerator:slac-linac as a downstream machine of PEP-II (a reversed link); it is fixed on the linac record, with the sources of the injection (PAC 1995, WAQ15).

beam_energy.note: Asymmetric rings: 9.0 GeV electrons in the high-energy ring, 3.1 GeV positrons in the low-energy ring; the quantity records the electron energy. SLAC's graduate handbook page gives slightly different design values ("9.1 GeV" and "3 GeV", centre-of-mass energy "about 10.5 GeV"); the BaBar detector paper agrees with 9.0 and 3.1 GeV.
beam_energy.quote: Utilization of the existing high power, low emittance beams available at SLAC required that a great portion of the systems for pulsed extraction and transport of 9.0 GeV electrons and 3.1 GeV positrons for injection into the PEP-II rings will reside in the existing linac housing.

circumference.quote: a pair of storage rings 2.2 km (1.4 mi) in circumference

cms_energy.locator: arXiv:hep-ex/0105044, Sec. 3.1 PEP-II Storage Rings; arXiv PDF p. 9
cms_energy.note: Design centre-of-mass energy (mass of the Υ(4S)). The introduction of the same paper (arXiv:hep-ex/0105044) gives the beam energies as 9.0 GeV (electrons) and 3.1 GeV (positrons).
cms_energy.quote: PEP-II is an e+ e− storage ring system designed to operate at a center of mass (c.m.) energy of 10.58 GeV, corresponding to the mass of the Υ (4S) resonance.

injection_energy.display: 9.0 GeV e⁻ and 3.1 GeV e⁺ (full-energy injection from the linac)
injection_energy.note: Injection energies equal the ring energies: the SLAC linac extracted 9.0 GeV electrons at Sector 10 and 3.1 GeV positrons at Sector 4 (same paper).
injection_energy.quote: Utilization of the existing high power, low emittance beams available at SLAC required that a great portion of the systems for pulsed extraction and transport of 9.0 GeV electrons and 3.1 GeV positrons for injection into the PEP-II rings will reside in the existing linac housing.

summary.plain: A particle collider at SLAC that smashed together electrons and positrons at slightly different energies to produce large numbers of B mesons, studied by the BaBar detector from 1999 to 2008.
summary.technical: PEP-II B-factory: an asymmetric-energy electron-positron collider at SLAC (9 GeV e⁻ × 3.1 GeV e⁺, cms 10.58 GeV, tuned to the Υ(4S) resonance), 2.2 km circumference, feeding the BaBar detector, 1999-2008.
